crossRefs.note: With my lips, I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.
I will also speak of your statutes before kings, and will not be disappointed.
The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.
I have proclaimed glad news of righteousness in the great assembly. Behold, I will not seal my lips, Yahweh, you know.
I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart. I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation. I have not…
We will not hide them from their children, telling to the generation to come the praises of Yahweh, his strength, and…
and you shall teach them diligently to your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you…
You offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth…
The good man out of his good treasure brings out good things, and the evil man out of his evil treasure brings out evil…
Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up as the need may be, that…
Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.
All of your commandments are faithful. They persecute me wrongfully. Help me!
You have commanded your statutes in righteousness. They are fully trustworthy.
Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness. Your law is truth.
Therefore the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, and righteous, and good.
For we know that the law is spiritual, but I am fleshly, sold under sin.

translations.web: Let my tongue sing of your word, for all your commandments are righteousness.
translations.bsb: My tongue sings of Your word, for all Your commandments are righteous.
translations.kjv: My tongue shall speak of thy word: for all thy commandments are righteousness.
translations.asv: Let my tongue sing of thy word; For all thy commandments are righteousness.
